title: Slim natural-fiber pants
summary: Slim only · no lounge pants · black/gray · 30×32 · 100% natural main fabric.

recommendation.title: No qualifying in-stock match verified
recommendation.text: The previous lounge, straight-cut and short-inseam options have been removed.
recommendation.test: This search found zero complete matches—not evidence that none exists anywhere. No substitutes are being recommended.

caveat: Slim fit and non-lounge construction are hard requirements. Synthetic trims may be disclosed separately, but elastane in the main fabric fails. No relaxation of fit, color, size or fabric is assumed.
evidenceNote: Checked specialist catalogs including Rawganique, KnowledgeCotton, HempAge, Asket, Nudie, Kuyichi, MUD Jeans, Kings of Indigo and organsk. Common blockers were elastane, wrong color and unavailable size. No four-option shortlist was established.
